messages.subject: External vector in mplusObject
parts:
Hi

Is there a way to define (what I in my immature R language call) an external vector, from inside an mplusObject? Coming from Stata, I would like to use what Stata what calls a local macro (think of a box to put something into, such as a file name) and that can be used within Stata's package runmplus. I would like to do the same in R and with mplusObject.

An example below: file_xx should automatically be substituted with a filename I have defined prior to running mplusOject

EXAMPLE...

file_xx <- actualfilename.dat

# code omitted

SAVEDATA = "
SAVE = fscores;
file = file_xxt ;",
rdata = selectedgroup)

...END OF EXAMPLE

I prefer mplusObject and mplusModeler over using an init section in an .inp file

Christopher

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: External vector in mplusObject
parts:
Yes, this should be quite straightforward. Here is a small extension of some code included in ?mplusObject:


fname <- "file12.txt"

      test4 <- mplusObject(
        TITLE = "test bootstrapping;",
        VARIABLE = "
          CATEGORICAL = cyl;
          WEIGHT = wt;
          USEVARIABLES = cyl mpg;",
        ANALYSIS = "ESTIMATOR = MLR;",
        MODEL = "
          cyl ON mpg;",
        SAVEDATA = paste0("SAVE=FSCORES; FILE=", fname),
        usevariables = c("mpg", "wt", "cyl"),
        rdata = mtcars)

Hope this helps,
Michael
